evidence.observation: Tube pressure gauge is not installed; pressure verification required during growth is unavailable.
Exhaust oxygen was 1.7 ppm at the start of growth.
Exhaust oxygen has progressively risen to 25.3 ppm, raising concern about atmosphere integrity without identifying a cause.
Temperature 749.5 °C and argon flow 100.3 sccm track their setpoints; pressure is unavailable despite controller status running.

args.missing_evidence: A validated tube-pressure measurement is required to verify the growth atmosphere; confirm the O2 rise with an independent check and assess atmosphere integrity. No sample characterization is available.
